name: HYDRA-UMC-SUITE
build: No pyproject.toml. __init__.py's __version__ is the real source. Packaged as standalone .exe using build_exe.bat/.sh.
notes: Desktop swarm command center, packaged as a standalone executable. Real server discovery (net/discovery.py): concurrent subnet /24 scan plus real mDNS (_hydra._tcp, matching what server.ts publishes and HYDRA-UMC-IOS-CONTROL already queries), deduplicated by (host, port). Every real-time robot control (joint jog, speed, acceleration) now fires the atomic, debounced /api/robot/:id/command path (net/client.py's HydraConnection.send_command(), debounce_ms) instead of the full-tree push_state() a continuously-dragged knob/slider used to call once per mouse event. tests/verify_discovery.py and tests/verify_send_command_debounce.py give the pure logic real, deterministic, no-network coverage (this repo has no pytest suite - verify_*.py scripts are its own real testing convention).
